note: Daily scan 18 Nov: second strike on a disabled LPG tanker off Khasab, and a drone attack on Iraq's Khor Mor gas field that cut 2.8 GW of power.

signals.source: Gulf News / Khaleej Times / TradeArabia: UAE business and utilities
signals.summary: The LPG tanker Tara Gas, disabled 7 nm north of Khasab on 16 Nov, was struck a second time and the crew abandoned ship; one Indian sailor is missing. Armed men tried to board a cargo ship off Mukalla on 17 Nov. The IMO counts 136 security incidents in the region from 1 Mar to 11 Nov, 35 of them in October. Araghchi-Oman talks in Muscat brought no breakthrough.
signals.check: Repeat strikes on disabled ships and the first missing crew member point to rising severity, likely pushing up war-risk premiums. Check supplier quotes and delivery dates for imported critical spares.
signals.notes: Opened Gulf News evening briefing (17 Nov, grade C) citing India's shipping minister and UKMTO; IMO figure per Al Jazeera 17 Nov. Continues SQ-0094.

signals.summary: Iraq's Khor Mor gas field, run partly by UAE-based Dana Gas, stopped production last week after a suspected drone attack caused a fire and cut 2.8 GW of power generation in the Kurdistan region; sirens sounded again on 16 Nov after another drone flew over. Kurdish officials blame Iran-backed groups.
signals.check: Shows how one strike on gas supply can take gigawatts off a grid. Check how the network would cope with a sudden loss of gas-fired generation and whether load-shedding plans are current.
signals.notes: Opened Al Jazeera (17 Nov) citing Reuters and Dana Gas. Outside the UAE; analogue for fuel-supply attack. Relevant to ER-02.
